summary: Meridian Holdings Inc. (formerly Golden Matrix Group; NASDAQ: MRDN) filed a Form 8-K on October 2, 2026, disclosing entry into a Tenth Amendment to the Amended and Restated Sale and Purchase Agreement of Share Capital governing its April 2024 acquisition of 100% of the MeridianBet Group from the Meridian Sellers and appointment/compensation matters under Item 5.02. The excerpt states no amendment terms, price, stake or dates beyond the original $10M and $10M post-closing payments and $15M of 7% promissory notes. Deal terms cannot be assessed; watch for amendment economics and any related-party governance implications.
